{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Filter for CONTROL arm and MODERATE severity
target_population = df[(df['arm'] == 'control') & (df['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check size of target population
print("Number of CONTROL-arm, MODERATE-severity patients:", len(target_population))

# Check how many responded (responded == 1)
responded_count = target_population['responded'].sum()
print("Number who responded:", responded_count)

# Compute fraction
fraction_responded = responded_count / len(target_population)
print("Fraction responded:", fraction_responded)

# Return fraction as float
fraction_responded"}
